fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring purity and tradition to your rituals with this beautifully handcrafted Brass Pooja Bowl. Designed with a floral pattern inside and a smooth golden finish, this bowl is perfect for holding water, milk, flowers, kumkum, rice, or other sacred offerings during puja and festive ceremonies. Crafted from high-quality brass, it ensures durability, shine, and a timeless appeal, making it a valuable addition to your Pooja room or as a thoughtful spiritual gift.
